title: DNA extraction for river samples
author: Maïlys Gauthier
materials: These steps are done under a biosafety cabinet

DAY 1 Place all the equipment under UV light for 15min before starting (beaker, elastics, Day 1 mesh, bench protection paper, TNES) Empty the ethanol from the bulk sample container into a beaker using 600 µm nylon mesh. Note : when pouring ethanol or TNES, make sure the mesh is taut and pulled tight at the elastic band to avoid leaks. Note : Check that no material (especially organisms) remains on the mesh. If any remain, return them to the bottle (e.g. by flicking the top of the mesh). Add TNES buffer ( 100 millimolar (mM), Tris-HCL , 100 millimolar (mM), EDTA , 1.5 Molarity (M), NaCl ) to get a 2:1 ratio (TNES:sample) and homogenize (12 pipettings). Note : Don't forget the treatment blank: 100 mL in an empty flask. Leave the samples in TNES Overnight at 4 °C

DAY 2 Place all the equipment under UV light for 15min before starting (beaker, elastics, mesh, tongs, Day 2 spatulas, beads, 2 bench protective papers) Recover Day 1 vials and keep on ice. Empty the TNES into a beaker using 600 µm nylon mesh. Note : when pouring TNES, make sure the mesh is taut and pulled tight at the elastic band to avoid leaks. Note : Check that no material (especially organisms) remains on the mesh. If any remain, return them to the bottle (e.g. by flicking the top of the mesh). Removing TNES before grinding Add 1 x 10 mm stainless steel beads and 100g of 5 mm stainless steel beads to the flask. Clean the bench and replace the protective paper with a new one. Grind with Geno/Grinder : - 3 cycles of : 5 * (2 min + 30 sec pause), 1500 rpm - 10 min pause between each cycle. Note : Run a cycle and check the sample's condition before starting a new one, stopping when the sample is fully ground up. Inside a kick-net sample before (A) and after (B) grinding with steel beads in the Geno/Grinder Back under the biosafety cabinet, proceed directly to weighing for extraction (see the first step of Extraction section). Note : At this stage, you can recover the beads (with tweezers if necessary) from the samples and return them to their boxes in the biosafety cabinet. This step can be carried out while the extraction tubes are being filled, or afterwards. Proceed to extraction or store at 4 °C or -20 °C until extraction.

steps.title: Settle beads in tube
steps.instruction: Spin the PowerBead Pro Tube briefly to bring the beads to the bottom.

steps.title: Add sample matrix and buffer
steps.instruction: Using a clean spatula, add up to 250 mg of matrix to the tube; for a treatment blank add 250 µL of TNES buffer.

steps.title: Add CD1 and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of Solution CD1, then homogenize on the Geno/Grinder at 15 000 rpm, °C, for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Load lysate onto column (first)
steps.instruction: Load 650 µL of lysate onto an MB Spin Column, centrifuge at 15 000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Load remaining lysate (repeat)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous loading step to ensure all lysate passes through the MB Spin Column; discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with EA
steps.instruction: Place the MB Spin Column in a clean 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Solution EA, centrifuge at 15 000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with C5
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Solution C5 to the MB Spin Column (still in the same collection tube), centrifuge at 15 000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry spin column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 16 000 × g, °C, for 2 minutes to remove residual buffer.

steps.title: Elute DNA with C6
steps.instruction: Place the MB Spin Column into a new 1.5 mL elution tube, add 70 µL Solution C6 to the centre of the membrane, centrifuge at 15 000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, discard the column; DNA is now ready for downstream applications.

steps.title: Store DNA frozen
steps.instruction: Store the DNA frozen at –30 °C to –15 °C or –90 °C to –65 °C; note that Solution C6 does not contain EDTA.

steps.title: Day 1 cleanup
steps.instruction: Empty the ethanol beaker into a liquid container and set aside; place dirty elastics and mesh aside.

steps.title: Day 2 cleanup
steps.instruction: Empty the buffer beaker; place dirty elastics and mesh aside; wash the elastics in demineralized water; decontaminate the beaker, beads, tweezers and spatulas by spraying with 5 % bleach, 0.5 % NaOH and 0.5 % detergent, let stand for 10 minutes, then rinse with demineralized water.
